name: Badia (Italy)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Badia (a black ibex on yellow above roses on white and red).
history: Municipal flag of Badia, a comune in Trentino-South Tyrol; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Badia arms — black ibex on yellow above roses on white and red
